title: Terrain
description: Areas of squares that change movement on one map: difficult terrain, water, slopes. See docs/design/maps.md section 9a. What each kind costs comes from the ruleset.

rect.description: [x, y, w, h]: w x h squares with (x, y) the top-left one.

kind.description: difficult and greater_difficult cost extra movement; uneven and narrow call for a balance check; climb and swim need that action unless the creature has the speed; hazardous deals damage.

cause.description: What makes it so (rubble, mud, water, ice, undergrowth, glass...). Rulesets use it for creatures that ignore some terrain.

active.description: false: the area starts switched off and applies once the save switches it on (terrain_on), for example water and mud where a bridge or pier will collapse.

dc.description: DC of the check the area calls for (Climb, Swim, Balance).

damage.description: Hazardous terrain: the damage and when it applies.

label.description: Short name for the board and narration.

note.description: GM-only: where this comes from and anything the table should know.

source.description: Save only: what created a temporary area (a spell, an ability).

until.description: Save only: when a temporary area ends, in words.
